description: This file defines a PHP class 'OX_Maintenance_Statistics_Task_LogCompletion' responsible for logging the completion of maintenance statistics tasks in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods to record task duration, update logs in the database, and store run reports, primarily for internal maintenance and statistics tracking.

classes.name: OX_Maintenance_Statistics_Task_LogCompletion
classes.description: A class that logs the completion of maintenance statistics tasks, including recording durations, updating database logs, and saving run reports.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the logging process for the completion of a maintenance statistics task, including duration calculation, database logging, and report storage.

methods.name: _setMaintenanceStatisticsRunReport
methods.description: Stores a maintenance statistics run report into the user log.
